name: Grupo Casas Bahia S.A.
summary: Operating in Brazil, Grupo Casas Bahia S.A., along with its various subsidiaries, is a prominent retailer specializing in electronics, home appliances, and furniture. Beyond its core retail operations, the company offers a suite of financial services, including popular "buy now pay later" options and credit card services. It also provides extensive logistics solutions such as fulfillment and fullcommerce services, and even manufactures wooden furniture. Customers can additionally benefit from extended warranty and equipment installation services. The group reaches its diverse customer base through both physical retail stores and extensive e-commerce platforms, utilizing a portfolio of well-known brands like Casas Bahia, Ponto, Extra.com, Bartira, banQi, Rede Celer, ASAPLog, and CNT, supported by its distribution centers. Formerly known as Via S.A. until its name change in September 2023, Grupo Casas Bahia S.A. was established in 1946 and is headquartered in São Paulo, Brazil.
